goal: Let a new user create an account with the minimum information needed, building trust step by step.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.description: Collect credentials only; defer profile data until after first value.

success.title: Welcome aboard!
success.message: Your account is ready. We sent a confirmation link to your email.

errors.message: An account with this email already exists.
errors.recovery: Offer sign-in and password-reset links next to the error.

errors.message: Password must be at least 12 characters.
errors.recovery: Keep entered email; focus the password field with inline guidance.
